requirements.text: [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] on a partial class implementing IMessagePackFormatter<T> makes the generator write that formatter in the consuming project
requirements.quote: Add a `[GeneratedMessagePackFormatter]` attribute that will work for partial classes implementing `IMessagePackFormatter<T>`.

requirements.text: The assembly that defines T does not reference MessagePack
requirements.quote: the latter has no (and cannot have) reference to MessagePack nuget package

requirements.text: How keys and settings (Key, Union...) are given for T: the issue lists three alternatives and picks none
requirements.quote: As for the attribute-based property keys and other settings (such as Union), I can think of 3 alternatives

alternatives.name: user-defined copies of the MessagePack attributes
